setup.summary: SPI 200 futures: not available. One undated quote (+0.78%) contradicted the overnight tone (US equities lower, yields at multi-year highs) and could not be verified, so it is excluded and no implied open is given. Prior ASX 200 close: 8,727, -0.09% (ABC; a Trading Economics CFD figure conflicted).

what_moved: US equities pulled back from Tuesday's record closes as Treasury yields hit 24-year highs (10-year about 5.35% intraday, 30-year near 5.70%) and September Fed minutes showed most officials expect another hike by year-end. Per Trading Economics, AI-infrastructure names fell while pharmaceuticals and consumer staples rose; S&P 500 sector percentages are not available.

news.headline: Fed minutes point to another hike.
news.summary: Most officials expect a further increase by year-end; markets price roughly 17-20% odds of a 25 bp move at the October meeting.

news.headline: Long-end yields at multi-decade highs.
news.summary: Treasury yields reached their highest since 2002 before easing after a solid 10-year auction.

news.headline: Oil firm on Middle East risk.
news.summary: Houthi attacks, Strait of Hormuz incidents and a Gulf storm lifted crude early; WTI later eased to about US$88.80.

news.headline: India lifts rates.
news.summary: The RBI raised its benchmark rate 25 bp to 5.5%, its first rise in almost four years, and signalled more could follow.

news.headline: Australian rate outlook.
news.summary: Former RBA board member Ian Harper said another rate rise this year is "plausible".

news.headline: Bitcoin falls.
news.summary: Down more than 3% to below US$83,000, weighing on crypto-linked US stocks.
